cross_product_finding: This page introduces capella:advanced-mode as a distinct access/feature-gating primitive that sits alongside (not instead of) the availableSince/version gating seen on search-index-params.json: a feature can require BOTH Couchbase Server 8.0 AND Advanced Mode simultaneously (see the Scoring Model relation above, which carries both gates). This is a genuinely different shape from server/'s requiresPrivilege (RBAC check against a logged-in user's roles) - Advanced Mode is a UI affordance toggle available to any user editing the index, with no privilege check implied by the text. Recommend the coordinator keep requiresUiMode separate from requiresPrivilege/requiresEdition rather than merging them, since 'privilege' and 'edition' both describe server-enforced constraints, while 'UI mode' describes a client-side editor setting.
